        String input = scanner.nextLine();

        int longestOutside = 0;
        int insideWordCount = 0;
        int currentOutsideLength = 0;
        boolean insideParenthesis = false;

                    insideParenthesis = true;
                    break;

                        insideWordCount++;
                    }
                    hasCurrentInsideWord = false;
                    break;

                case '_':

                        longestOutside = currentOutsideLength;
                    }
                    currentOutsideLength = 0;
                    if (hasCurrentInsideWord) {
                        insideWordCount++;
                    }
                    hasCurrentInsideWord = false;
                    break;

                default:
                    if (insideParenthesis) {
                        hasCurrentInsideWord = true;
                    } else {
                        currentOutsideLength++;
                    }
                    break;
            }
        }

        if (currentOutsideLength > longestOutside) {
            longestOutside = currentOutsideLength;

        System.out.println(longestOutside + " " + insideWordCount);

                    i++;

                }

        int prevWord = 0;
        int inBrackets = 0;
        int word = 0;
        boolean bracket = false;
        boolean brackword = false;

        if (n > 0) {
            int end = Math.min(n, in.length());
            Matcher matcher = Pattern.compile("[^()_]+|[()_]").matcher(in);

                if (token.length() > 1) {

                    } else {
                        word += token.length();
                    }

                }

                char c = token.charAt(0);

                    word = 0;
                    bracket = true;

                    bracket = false;

                    brackword = false;
                } else if (c == '_') {
                    if (word > prevWord) prevWord = word;
                    word = 0;
                    if (brackword) inBrackets++;
                    brackword = false;
                } else {
                    if (bracket) {
                        brackword = true;
                    } else {
                        word++;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (n > in.length()) {
            in.charAt(in.length());
        }

        if (word > prevWord) prevWord = word;
        System.out.println(prevWord + " " + inBrackets);
    }
